# ProcessType

The kind of a run.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"App"` | An app run. |
| `"Interaction"` | An interaction run. |
| `"Capsule"` | A capsule run. |
| `"CodePipeline"` | A code pipeline run. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.
